title: 第3章 一巴掌打醒第4章 玉佩规则初探
slug: 我能穿越去修仙你跟我分手
content_zh:
王绅说着话，自始至终都没看邻桌那两个跳脚的小丑一眼，仿佛他们就是两团碍眼的空气。
姜瑶脸上的血色“唰”地褪了个干净，紧接着又涨成猪肝色。
她指着林渊的鼻子就破口大骂。
『“好啊你，林渊！”
“为了在我面前装，你还花钱找人来演戏！”
“你可真行！”
“演得跟真的一样！”』
“啪！”
一声脆响。
不是巴掌，是富二代男友手里的名牌手机失手掉在地上。
他一把捂住姜瑶的嘴，脸色白得像纸，额头上冷汗瞬间就下来了。
他冲着王绅远去的背影，几乎是九十度鞠躬，声音都在发颤。
『“王总！王总！”
“她不懂事，有眼不识泰山！”
“您千万别往心里去！”
“您忙您的！”』
林渊不屑地扫了一眼这两个小丑，转头对顾小北温和道：
“小北，这里有噪音，咱进里面吧，别让王总久等。”
“好的！”
顾小北乖乖点头，跟着林渊和王绅一起进去。

……
几人走远后，富二代这才松开手，魂飞魄散地瘫坐在椅子上，腿肚子都在打颤。
姜瑶被他突如其来的举动弄懵了，又气又委屈，眼泪在眼眶里打转。
『“亲爱的你干什么！”
“他一个穷鬼找来的演员，你怕成这样？”』
“演员？”
富二代看她的眼神，像在看一个无可救药的白痴。
『“那是济安阁的王绅！”
“王老神医的大儿子！”
“我爷爷当年就是王老神医给救回来的！”
“整个江都市，谁敢不给他几分面子？”
“我爸见了他都得客客气气叫声‘王总’！”
“你差点把我们家都给害死！”』
姜瑶的脑子一片空白。
王绅……
济安阁……
content_en:
While Wang Shen was talking, he never glanced at the two jumping clowns at the next table, as if they were just two eyesores.
The blood on Jiang Yao's face suddenly faded away, and then turned into the color of pig liver again.
She pointed at Lin Yuan's nose and cursed.
""Okay, Lin Yuan!"
"In order to pretend to be in front of me, you paid someone to act!"
"You're really good!"
"It's just like the real thing!"
"Crack!"
There was a crisp sound.
It wasn't a slap, it was the brand-name mobile phone in the hand of the rich second-generation boyfriend's hand that fell to the ground.
He covered Jiang Yao's mouth, his face was as white as paper, and cold sweat immediately fell from his forehead.
He bowed almost ninety degrees towards Wang Shen's retreating back, his voice trembling.
"Mr. Wang! Mr. Wang!"
"She is ignorant and has blind eyes!"
"Don't take it personally!"
"You are busy with your business!"』
Lin Yuan glanced at the two clowns with disdain, turned to Gu Xiaobei and said gently:
"Xiao Bei, there is noise here. Let's go inside. Don't keep Mr. Wang waiting."
"Okay!"
Gu Xiaobei nodded obediently and followed Lin Yuan and Wang Shen in.
…
After a few people walked away, the second-generation rich man let go of his hand and slumped down on the chair in a daze, his legs and legs trembling.
Jiang Yao was confused by his sudden move, angry and aggrieved, with tears welling up in her eyes.
""Honey, what are you doing!"
"He is an actor hired by a poor man. Are you afraid that he will end up like this?"
"Actor?"
The rich second generation looked at her like she was looking at a hopeless idiot.
""That's Wang Shen from Ji'an Pavilion!"
"The eldest son of Mr. Wang, the miracle doctor!"
"My grandfather was saved by the miraculous doctor Mr. Wang back then!"
"Who in the entire Jiangdu City dares not to give him some face?"
"My dad has to politely call him 'Mr. Wang' when he sees him!"
"You almost killed our family!"』
Jiang Yao's mind went blank.
Wang Shen...
Ji'an Pavilion...
